titles.it: Apprendista Gestore del commercio al dettaglio AFC - Lugano
titles.fr: Apprenti Gestionnaire du commerce de détail AFC - Lugano

descriptions.it:
Che ne dici di muovere i primi passi verso il futuro? Sunrise ti offre più di un semplice apprendistato: ti dà l’opportunità di appartenere a un ambiente lavorativo moderno, stimolante, ricco di opportunità e sfide.

Ami la tecnologia e il contatto diretto con le persone? In qualità di impiegato/a del commercio al dettaglio AFC presso Sunrise, sarai sempre in prima linea: fornirai consulenza ai clienti, creerai esperienze di acquisto indimenticabili e metterai in gioco tutto il tuo entusiasmo relativo a smartphone, tablet, tecnologia e intrattenimento. Per conto tuo o in team, qui potrai dimostrare ciò di cui sei capace!

A Lugano abbiamo un posto di apprendistato vacante nella seguente sede:

## Sunrise Shop Lugano Piazza Dante, Piazza Dante 7, 6900 Lugano

I tuoi punti di forza:

- ti piacciono i rapporti interpersonali e le tecnologie di comunicazione - la media della tua ultima pagella scolastica è di almeno 4

- ottima capacità di espressione in francese - comportamento irreprensibile sul lavoro ed eccellenti capacità relazionali e di apprendimento

Ti rendiamo adatto al mercato del lavoro. Con noi non solo imparerai, ma sperimenterai anche che cosa significa lavorare in modo motivato e divertente. Costruiamo insieme il tuo futuro! Da noi non sei mai da solo, sarai sempre seguito e aiutato personalmente dal nostro team di formatori. Lo spirito di squadra tra gli apprendisti di Sunrise è leggendario. Sei interessato? Allora inviaci la tua candidatura!

Unisciti al nostro team e plasmiamo insieme il futuro!

#ChallengersWanted

Hai delle domande? Chiamaci al numero 0800 300 100 o inviaci un'e-mail a lehre@sunrise.net.
descriptions.en: How about taking the first steps towards the future? Sunrise offers you more than just an apprenticeship: it gives you the opportunity to belong to a modern, stimulating working environment, full of opportunities and challenges. Do you love technology and direct contact with people? As an AFC Retail Associate at Sunrise, you'll always be on the front lines: advising customers, creating unforgettable shopping experiences and bringing all your enthusiasm for smartphones, tablets, technology and entertainment to the table. On your own or in a team, here you can demonstrate what you are capable of! In Lugano we have a vacant apprenticeship position in the following location: ## Sunrise Shop Lugano Piazza Dante, Piazza Dante 7, 6900 Lugano Your strengths: - you like interpersonal relationships and communication technologies - the average of your last school report is at least 4 - excellent ability to express yourself in French - impeccable behavior at work and excellent relational and learning skills We make you suitable for the job market. With us you will not only learn, but also experience what it means to work in a motivated and fun way. Let's build your future together! With us you are never alone, you will always be followed and helped personally by our team of trainers. The team spirit among Sunrise apprentices is legendary. Are you interested? Then send us your application! Join our team and let's shape the future together! #ChallengersWanted Do you have any questions? Call us on 0800 300 100 or email us at lehre@sunrise.net.
descriptions.de: Wie wäre es mit den ersten Schritten in die Zukunft? Sunrise bietet Ihnen mehr als nur eine Ausbildung: Es gibt Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Teil eines modernen, anregenden Arbeitsumfelds voller Möglichkeiten und Herausforderungen zu sein. Du liebst Technik und den direkten Kontakt mit Menschen? Als AFC Retail Associate bei Sunrise stehen Sie immer an vorderster Front: Sie beraten Kunden, schaffen unvergessliche Einkaufserlebnisse und bringen Ihre ganze Begeisterung für Smartphones, Tablets, Technologie und Unterhaltung ein. Ob alleine oder im Team, hier können Sie zeigen, was Sie können! In Lugano haben wir eine freie Lehrstelle an folgendem Standort: ## Sunrise Shop Lugano Piazza Dante, Piazza Dante 7, 6900 Lugano Deine Stärken: - Du magst zwischenmenschliche Beziehungen und Kommunikationstechnologien - der Durchschnitt Deines letzten Schulzeugnisses liegt bei mindestens 4 - ausgezeichnete Fähigkeit, sich auf Französisch auszudrücken - tadelloses Verhalten am Arbeitsplatz und ausgezeichnete Beziehungs- und Lernfähigkeiten Wir machen Dich fit für den Arbeitsmarkt. Bei uns lernen Sie nicht nur, sondern erleben auch, was es bedeutet, motiviert und mit Spaß zu arbeiten. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam Ihre Zukunft gestalten! Bei uns sind Sie nie allein, sondern werden stets persönlich von unserem Trainerteam begleitet und betreut. Der Teamgeist unter den Sunrise-Lernenden ist legendär. Sind Sie interessiert? Dann senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung! Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und lassen Sie uns gemeinsam die Zukunft gestalten! #ChallengersWanted Haben Sie Fragen? Rufen Sie uns unter 0800 300 100 an oder schreiben Sie uns eine E-Mail an lehre@sunrise.net.
descriptions.fr: Et si vous faisiez les premiers pas vers l’avenir ? Sunrise vous offre bien plus qu'un simple apprentissage : il vous donne la possibilité d'appartenir à un environnement de travail moderne et stimulant, plein d'opportunités et de défis. Vous aimez la technologie et le contact direct avec les gens ? En tant qu'associé de vente au détail AFC chez Sunrise, vous serez toujours en première ligne : conseiller les clients, créer des expériences de magasinage inoubliables et apporter tout votre enthousiasme pour les smartphones, les tablettes, la technologie et le divertissement. Seul ou en équipe, vous pourrez ici démontrer de quoi vous êtes capable ! À Lugano, nous avons un poste d'apprentissage vacant à l'endroit suivant : ## Sunrise Shop Lugano Piazza Dante, Piazza Dante 7, 6900 Lugano Vos atouts : - vous aimez les relations interpersonnelles et les technologies de la communication - la moyenne de votre dernier bulletin scolaire est d'au moins 4 - une excellente capacité à vous exprimer en français - un comportement de travail impeccable et d'excellentes capacités relationnelles et d'apprentissage Nous vous préparons au marché du travail. Avec nous, vous apprendrez non seulement, mais vous découvrirez également ce que signifie travailler de manière motivée et amusante. Construisons ensemble votre avenir ! Avec nous vous n'êtes jamais seul, vous serez toujours suivi et aidé personnellement par notre équipe de formateurs. L'esprit d'équipe parmi les apprentis de Sunrise est légendaire. Êtes-vous intéressé? Alors envoyez-nous votre candidature ! Rejoignez notre équipe et façonnons ensemble l'avenir ! #ChallengersWanted Vous avez des questions ? Appelez-nous au 0800 300 100 ou envoyez-nous un e-mail à lehre@sunrise.net.

descriptions.it: In Sunrise pensiamo in grande, andiamo oltre le convenzioni e forgiamo l’innovazione. Per noi cultura del lavoro significa realizzare grandi cose insieme. Qui, il rispetto e le nuove idee danno vita al vero lavoro di squadra: ogni voce viene valorizzata e ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a sperimentare cose nuove e a crescere costantemente. Ti riconosci in questo approccio? Allora, contribuisci a scrivere insieme a noi una storia di successo. Gli eroi del Frontline rappresentano l'orgoglio e l'eccellenza di Sunrise. Con soluzioni personalizzate e un servizio di primo ordine, essi trasformano ogni interazione con i clienti in un rapporto duraturo e di fiducia. LA TUA CHALLENGE: - Sei il volto di Sunrise e conquisti i nostri clienti con il tuo carisma positivo, la tua consulenza mirata e la vendita dei nostri numerosi prodotti Sunrise. - Instaura relazioni durature con i clienti e garantisci un'atmosfera eccellente nel negozio. - Assisti i clienti per questioni relative a riparazioni e assistenza, agendo in modo professionale e orientato alla soluzione. - Ti occuperai della gestione del magazzino e dell'inventario e svolgerai in modo efficiente le mansioni amministrative. - Vivrai e rappresenterai i valori di Sunrise: innovazione, vicinanza al cliente e servizio eccellente. LE TUE SKILLS: - Hai completato una formazione nel settore della vendita al dettaglio, idealmente con esperienza nel settore delle telecomunicazioni o multimediale, oppure sei un candidato motivato proveniente da un altro settore con attitudine alla vendita. - Sei entusiasta della tecnologia, delle telecomunicazioni e delle tendenze digitali. - La tua passione per la vendita è palpabile e il tuo atteggiamento professionale ti rendono un vero professionista delle vendite. - Ti piace lavorare con le persone e sei in grado di individuare rapidamente le loro esigenze. - Grazie alla tua pazienza e alle tue conoscenze tecniche, diventerai un eroe quotidiano per i nostri clienti. - Hai un'ottima conoscenza dell'italiano, ogni altra lingua è un plus. - Hai una grande flessibilità, affidabilità e apertura mentale per un settore in rapida evoluzione. Da Sunrise, lavoriamo in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale dove ogni voce conta, le prospettive si condividono e i valori si vivono. La diversità è nel nostro DNA. Celebrando le differenze, otteniamo grandi risultati insieme. Sunrise è partner di «Advance Gender Equality in Business», titolare del marchio svizzero LGBTI e certificata «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» per la parità retributiva a parità di lavoro. Unisciti al nostro team e plasmiamo insieme il futuro! #ChallengersWanted Nota per le agenzie: i documenti di candidatura inviati da agenzie di collocamento non saranno considerati e verranno cancellati. #LI-TW1
descriptions.en: At Sunrise, we think big, go beyond conventions, and forge innovation. For us, work culture means achieving great things together. Here, respect and new ideas bring true teamwork to life: every voice is valued, and every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion drives us to try new things and grow constantly. Do you recognize yourself in this approach? Then, let's contribute to writing a success story together. The Frontline heroes represent Sunrise's pride and excellence. With personalized solutions and top-notch service, they turn every customer interaction into a lasting and trusting relationship. YOUR CHALLENGE: - You are the face of Sunrise, conquering our customers with your positive charisma, targeted consulting, and sales of our numerous Sunrise products. - Build lasting relationships with customers and ensure an excellent atmosphere in the store. - Assist customers with repair and support issues, acting professionally and solution-oriented. - You will manage inventory and warehouse, and efficiently handle administrative tasks. - Live and represent Sunrise values: innovation, customer closeness, and excellent service. YOUR SKILLS: - You have completed retail sales training, ideally with experience in telecommunications or multimedia, or you're a motivated candidate from another field with a sales attitude. - You're enthusiastic about technology, telecommunications, and digital trends. - Your passion for sales is palpable, and your professional attitude makes you a true sales professional. - You enjoy working with people and can quickly identify their needs. - Thanks to your patience and technical knowledge, you'll become a daily hero for our customers. - You have excellent Italian language skills; any other language is a plus. - You have great flexibility, reliability, and open-mindedness for a rapidly evolving industry. At Sunrise, we work in a dynamic and international environment where every voice counts, perspectives are shared, and values are lived. Diversity is in our DNA. By celebrating differences, we achieve great results together. Sunrise is a partner of «Advance Gender Equality in Business», holder of the Swiss LGBTI brand, and certified «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» for pay equality for equal work. Join our team and shape the future together! #ChallengersWanted Note to agencies: job applications sent by recruitment agencies will not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-TW1
descriptions.de: Bei Sunrise denken wir groß, gehen über Konventionen hinaus und prägen Innovation. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur, gemeinsam großartige Dinge zu erreichen. Hier bringen Respekt und neue Ideen wahre Teamarbeit zum Leben: jede Stimme wird geschätzt und jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, neue Dinge auszuprobieren und ständig zu wachsen. Erkennst du dich in diesem Ansatz wieder? Dann lass uns gemeinsam eine Erfolgsgeschichte schreiben. Die Frontline-Helden repräsentieren Stolz und Exzellenz von Sunrise. Mit personalisierten Lösungen und erstklassigem Service verwandeln sie jede Kundeninteraktion in eine dauerhafte und vertrauensvolle Beziehung. DEINE HERAUSFORDERUNG: - Du bist das Gesicht von Sunrise, gewinnst unsere Kunden mit deinem positiven Charisma, gezielter Beratung und dem Verkauf unserer zahlreichen Sunrise-Produkte. - Baue dauerhafte Beziehungen zu Kunden auf und sorge für eine exzellente Atmosphäre im Geschäft. - Unterstütze Kunden bei Reparatur- und Supportanfragen, handle professionell und lösungsorientiert. - Du wirst dich um die Verwaltung von Lager und Inventar kümmern und administrative Aufgaben effizient erledigen. - Lebe und repräsentiere die Werte von Sunrise: Innovation, Kundennähe und exzellenter Service. DEINE FÄHIGKEITEN: - Du hast eine Ausbildung im Einzelhandel abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit Erfahrung im Telekommunikations- oder Multimedia-Bereich, oder bist ein motivierter Kandidat aus einem anderen Bereich mit Verkaufseinstellung. - Du bist begeistert von Technologie, Telekommunikation und digitalen Trends. - Deine Leidenschaft für Verkauf ist spürbar und deine professionelle Einstellung macht dich zu einem echten Vertriebsprofi. - Du genießt es, mit Menschen zu arbeiten und kannst ihre Bedürfnisse schnell erkennen. - Dank deiner Geduld und technischen Kenntnisse wirst du zu einem täglichen Helden für unsere Kunden. - Du hast ausgezeichnete Italienisch-Kenntnisse; jede andere Sprache ist ein Plus. - Du hast eine große Flexibilität, Zuverlässigkeit und Offenheit für eine sich schnell entwickelnde Branche. Bei Sunrise arbeiten wir in einer dynamischen und internationalen Umgebung, in der jede Stimme zählt, Perspektiven geteilt werden und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist in unserem DNA. Indem wir Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam großartige Ergebnisse. Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Inhaber der Schweizer LGBTI-Marke und zertifiziert «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für Lohngleichheit bei gleicher Arbeit. Werde Teil unseres Teams und forme die Zukunft gemeinsam! #ChallengersWanted Hinweis für Agenturen: Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlern werden nicht berücksichtigt und gelöscht. #LI-TW1
descriptions.fr: Chez Sunrise, nous pensons en grand, allons au-delà des conventions et forgeons l'innovation. Pour nous, la culture de travail signifie réaliser de grandes choses ensemble. Ici, le respect et les nouvelles idées donnent vie à un véritable travail d'équipe : chaque voix est valorisée et chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à essayer de nouvelles choses et à grandir constamment. Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette approche ? Alors, contribuons à écrire ensemble une histoire de succès. Les héros du Frontline représentent la fierté et l'excellence de Sunrise. Avec des solutions personnalisées et un service de premier ordre, ils transforment chaque interaction avec les clients en une relation durable et de confiance. VOTRE DÉFI : - Vous êtes le visage de Sunrise, conquérant nos clients avec votre charisme positif, votre conseil ciblé et la vente de nos nombreux produits Sunrise. - Établissez des relations durables avec les clients et assurez une atmosphère excellente dans le magasin. - Aidez les clients avec des problèmes de réparation et de support, agissant de manière professionnelle et orientée vers la solution. - Vous occuperez de la gestion de l'inventaire et du stock, et effectuerez efficacement les tâches administratives. - Vivez et représentez les valeurs de Sunrise : innovation, proximité avec le client et service excellent. VOS COMPÉTENCES : - Vous avez terminé une formation dans le domaine de la vente au détail, idéalement avec une expérience dans le domaine des télécommunications ou des médias, ou vous êtes un candidat motivé issu d'un autre domaine avec une attitude de vente. - Vous êtes enthousiaste à l'égard de la technologie, des télécommunications et des tendances numériques. - Votre passion pour la vente est palpable et votre attitude professionnelle fait de vous un véritable professionnel de la vente. - Vous aimez travailler avec les gens et pouvez rapidement identifier leurs besoins. - Grâce à votre patience et à vos connaissances techniques, vous deviendrez un héros quotidien pour nos clients. - Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de l'italien ; toute autre langue est un plus. - Vous avez une grande flexibilité, une fiabilité et une ouverture d'esprit pour un secteur en évolution rapide. Chez Sunrise, nous travaillons dans un environnement dynamique et international où chaque voix compte, les perspectives sont partagées et les valeurs sont vécues. La diversité est dans notre ADN. En célébrant les différences, nous obtenons de grands résultats ensemble. Sunrise est partenaire de « Advance Gender Equality in Business », titulaire de la marque LGBTI suisse et certifiée « Fair-ON-Pay Advanced » pour l'égalité des salaires à travail égal. Rejoignez notre équipe et façonnez l'avenir ensemble ! #ChallengersWanted Note aux agences : les documents de candidature envoyés par des agences de placement ne seront pas considérés et seront supprimés. #LI-TW1

descriptions.en: In Sunrise we think great, we go beyond conventions and we provide innovation. For us culture of work means creating great things together. Do you recognize yourself in this approach? So, help us write a success story together. The heroes of the Frontline represent the pride and excellence of Sunrise. With customized solutions and a first-order service, they transform each interaction with customers into a lasting and trusted relationship. YOUR CHALLENGE: - You are the face of Sunrise and conquer our customers with your positive charism, your targeted advice and the sale of our many Sunrise products. - Establish lasting relationships with customers and ensure an excellent atmosphere in the store. - Assist customers for repair and service issues, acting in a professional and solution-oriented manner. - You will manage the warehouse and inventory and perform administrative tasks efficiently. - You will live and represent Sunrise values: innovation, customer proximity and excellent service. LE TUE SKILLS: - You have completed a training in the retail sector, ideally experienced in the telecommunications or multimedia sector, or you are a motivated candidate from another sector with aptitude for sale. You're excited about technology, telecommunications and digital trends. - Your passion for sale is palpable and your professional attitude makes you a real sales professional. You like to work with people and you can quickly identify their needs. Thanks to your patience and technical knowledge, you will become a daily hero for our customers. - You have an excellent knowledge of Italian, every other language is a plus. - You have great flexibility, reliability and mental openness for a rapidly changing industry. From Sunrise, we work in a dynamic and international environment where each voice counts, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity is in our DNA. Celebrating differences, we get great results together. Sunrise is a partner of «Advance Gender Equality in Business», owner of the Swiss LGBTI brand and certified «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» for equal pay. descriptions.it:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

As Head of Data Science & Analytics, you will work at the intersection of data, decision science, and real-world impact. You will lead a team of 10 specialists to address some of Sunrise’s most critical business challenges, applying rigorous analysis guided by pragmatic judgment to ensure decisions are both well-founded and actionable. As a leader, you will act as a coach, translator, builder, and strategist, shaping how data informs decisions across the organization.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Lead and develop the Data Science & Analytics team, including coaching, capability building, and people development
- Define what good looks like for Data Science & Analytics by setting standards and best practices, supported by playbooks, training materials, and delivery frameworks
- Ensure high-quality delivery across Data Science & Analytics contributions in a matrix setup
- Partner closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and senior leaders to translate business questions into analytical problems, and turn insights into decisions
- Support high-value decisions through analytics, experimentation, impact measurement, and advanced analytical methods such as causal inference - bringing rigorous evidence and constructive challenge to the company’s most important questions
- Build a community for data-driven decision-making across Sunrise by driving knowledge exchange, promoting best practices, and raising analytical fluency across the organization

YOUR SKILLS:

- Proven people leadership experience, including line management, coaching, and developing high-performing teams
- Strong expertise in advanced analytics for decisioning, ideally including causal inference, experimentation, impact measurement, and related statistical methods, supported by an advanced degree in a STEM field, economics, business informatics, or similar
- Deep hands-on analytics coding skills, ideally in both Python and R, with the ability to guide others on methodological and technical quality
- Excellent advisory and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders credibly, constructively challenge assumptions, and turn analysis into decisions
- Strong business acumen and the ability to focus teams on the work that creates the highest return on investment
- A pragmatic consulting mindset paired with strong delivery focus and sound judgment
- Fluency in English; German advantageous

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

#ChallengersWanted

descriptions.it:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story. At ADAO (AI, Data and Agentic Enablement Office), we bring people together to unlock the future of Sunrise through data, analytics, AI, and agentic technologies. We think big, move with purpose, and turn ideas into real impact for our customers and teams. ADAO is where innovation meets trust: we build strong data foundations, scale safe and reliable AI capabilities, and empower business units through a hub‑and‑spoke operating model to deliver meaningful results across the company. Within this model, you will work as part of the Agentic Enablement and Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design team, where the central hub provides standards, platforms, architecture, and best practices, while cross‑functional, outcome‑driven Pods are embedded in and led by the business. You will act as an engineering expert, partnering closely with the business to deliver on their priorities and outcomes. In this role you will enable Sunrise to design, deploy and continuously improve production‑grade agentic and conversational AI solutions across customer and employee workflows. You will provide shared frameworks, standards and quality gates to ensure AI behaviour is predictable, grounded in governed enterprise knowledge and data, safe, multilingual and operationally ready. You will partner with ADAO Domain Pods and engineering teams to accelerate delivery through reusable prompt/agent patterns, evaluation harnesses and disciplined release management. YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Agentic Systems Architecture:Design and evolve enterprise agent frameworks including orchestration, tool/function calling, workflow integration, retrieval/grounding and state managementDevelop reusable agent infrastructure (“Agent Factory”) consisting of modular agent templates, tool adapters, prompt modules, evaluation pipelines, and reference implementations to enable scalable and consistent deployment.Engineer structured single-agent and multi-agent systems with clearly defined reasoning boundaries, escalation paths and autonomy levelsDefine architectural patterns for distributed agent workflows across domains and business Pods
- Design and evolve enterprise agent frameworks including orchestration, tool/function calling, workflow integration, retrieval/grounding and state management
- Develop reusable agent infrastructure (“Agent Factory”) consisting of modular agent templates, tool adapters, prompt modules, evaluation pipelines, and reference implementations to enable scalable and consistent deployment.
- Engineer structured single-agent and multi-agent systems with clearly defined reasoning boundaries, escalation paths and autonomy levels
- Define architectural patterns for distributed agent workflows across domains and business Pods

- Reliable LLM Engineering:Implement reliability patterns for LLM-based systems including fallback strategies, structured output validation, deterministic routing and failure containment mechanismsOptimize latency, token efficiency and cost-per-interaction while maintaining quality thresholdsApply context management and grounding techniques to ensure predictable and auditable behavior
- Implement reliability patterns for LLM-based systems including fallback strategies, structured output validation, deterministic routing and failure containment mechanisms
- Optimize latency, token efficiency and cost-per-interaction while maintaining quality thresholds
- Apply context management and grounding techniques to ensure predictable and auditable behavior

- Prompt Engineering & Conversation Logic:Engineer high-quality prompts and system instructions for safe, grounded and structured agent behaviorDefine and maintain prompt libraries, versioning standards and regression testing practicesDesign multilingual (DE/FR/IT/EN) conversational flows aligned with enterprise and regulatory standards
- Engineer high-quality prompts and system instructions for safe, grounded and structured agent behavior
- Define and maintain prompt libraries, versioning standards and regression testing practices
- Design multilingual (DE/FR/IT/EN) conversational flows aligned with enterprise and regulatory standards

- Evaluation & Quality Control:Design and maintain evaluation harnesses including regression suites, golden conversations and structured scoring frameworks Define measurable acceptance thresholds and release readiness criteriaMonitor production behavior including grounding quality, hallucination risk, escalation patterns and performance metrics
- Design and maintain evaluation harnesses including regression suites, golden conversations and structured scoring frameworks Define measurable acceptance thresholds and release readiness criteria
- Monitor production behavior including grounding quality, hallucination risk, escalation patterns and performance metrics

- Production Integration & Observability:Integrate agentic systems into enterprise channels and backend services with robust authorization, state handling and error management Implement observability standards including traces, logs, telemetry and structured evaluation reporting Support go-live, hypercare and post-incident improvement cycles
- Integrate agentic systems into enterprise channels and backend services with robust authorization, state handling and error management Implement observability standards including traces, logs, telemetry and structured evaluation reporting Support go-live, hypercare and post-incident improvement cycles

- Safety, Risk & Governance:Implement bounded autonomy and human-in-the-loop control patternsEnforce guardrails, policy compliance and PII protection mechanismsCollaborate with Security, Privacy and Governance teams to ensure enterprise-grade compliance
- Implement bounded autonomy and human-in-the-loop control patterns
- Enforce guardrails, policy compliance and PII protection mechanisms
- Collaborate with Security, Privacy and Governance teams to ensure enterprise-grade compliance

- Examples of what you’ll help build:AI Agents to Enhance Customer Operations: Design and implement intelligent agents that analyze customer requests, identify root causes, and suggest effective resolution paths, helping improve service quality, consistency and operational efficiencyExpansion of an Enterprise Multi-Agent Framework: Develop and integrate new specialized agents into a scalable multi-agent architecture to automate workflows, support internal teams, and continuously improve operational processesDeployment of AI Copilots for Internal Teams: Work closely with business stakeholders to introduce task-focused AI copilots that assist with activities such as case analysis, information retrieval, and process coordination, reducing manual effort and accelerating turnaround times
- AI Agents to Enhance Customer Operations: Design and implement intelligent agents that analyze customer requests, identify root causes, and suggest effective resolution paths, helping improve service quality, consistency and operational efficiency
- Expansion of an Enterprise Multi-Agent Framework: Develop and integrate new specialized agents into a scalable multi-agent architecture to automate workflows, support internal teams, and continuously improve operational processes
- Deployment of AI Copilots for Internal Teams: Work closely with business stakeholders to introduce task-focused AI copilots that assist with activities such as case analysis, information retrieval, and process coordination, reducing manual effort and accelerating turnaround times

YOUR SKILLS:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI or equivalent practical experience
- Strong hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or agentic systems in production
- Deep understanding of:Tool/function calling and structured outputsRetrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)Multi-step workflows and orchestration logicContext management and reliability techniques for LLM systems
- Tool/function calling and structured outputs
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Multi-step workflows and orchestration logic
- Context management and reliability techniques for LLM systems
- Experience implementing evaluation frameworks and regression testing for AI systems
- Experience integrating AI services into backend systems and cloud-native environments
- Strong software engineering skills in Python, API design and containerized deployments
- Familiarity with observability, monitoring and production operations for distributed systems
- Ability to reason about system boundaries, autonomy levels and failure modes
- Experience working in cross-functional product teams in federated or hub-and-spoke delivery environments
- Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». You will provide shared frameworks, standards and quality gates to ensure AI behaviour is predictable, grounded in governed enterprise knowledge and data, safe, multilingual and operationally ready. - Schnittstellenfunktion: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit PreSales, Produktmanagement und Engineering; Übergabe in die Realisierung (Solution Handover) inkl. Deliverability‑Check und Qualitätskriterien
- Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Aktive Zertifizierungs‑ und Trainingsbereitschaft (Hersteller‑Zertifikate je nach Bedarf); Markt‑ und Technologieradar

DEINE SKILLS:

- Breites technisches Wissen über WAN, LAN/WLAN, Security, Cloud, Workplace, Storage und ganzheitliche ICT-Architekturen im KMU-Kontext
- Verkäuferisches Flair und sicheres Auftreten bei Kunden (Workshops, Präsentationen, Events/Webinare)
- Vertrauensbildende, angenehme Art; kann durch Kompetenz und Klarheit überzeugen
- Offen & neugierig für neue Technologien/Trends, zugleich fokussiert auf Kundenlösungen
- Erfahrung in Angeboten/RFPs (Struktur, technische Antwort, Annahmen/Risiken)
- Unternehmerisches Denken & Handeln mit Sinn für Wirtschaftlichkeit und Machbarkeit
- Teamplayer mit vernetztem Denken; Schnittstellenkompetenz zwischen PreSales/PM/Engineering
- Sprachen: Deutsch & Englisch fliessend (Wort/Schrift); weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

descriptions.it: At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story. As Head of Data Science & Analytics, you will work at the intersection of data, decision science, and real-world impact. You will lead a team of 10 specialists to address some of Sunrise’s most critical business challenges, applying rigorous analysis guided by pragmatic judgment to ensure decisions are both well-founded and actionable. As a leader, you will act as a coach, translator, builder, and strategist, shaping how data informs decisions across the organization. YOUR CHALLENGE: - Lead and develop the Data Science & Analytics team, including coaching, capability building, and people development - Define what good looks like for Data Science & Analytics by setting standards and best practices, supported by playbooks, training materials, and delivery frameworks - Ensure high-quality delivery across Data Science & Analytics contributions in a matrix setup - Partner closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and senior leaders to translate business questions into analytical problems, and turn insights into decisions - Support high-value decisions through analytics, experimentation, impact measurement, and advanced analytical methods such as causal inference - bringing rigorous evidence and constructive challenge to the company’s most important questions - Build a community for data-driven decision-making across Sunrise by driving knowledge exchange, promoting best practices, and raising analytical fluency across the organization YOUR SKILLS: - Proven people leadership experience, including line management, coaching, and developing high-performing teams - Strong expertise in advanced analytics for decisioning, ideally including causal inference, experimentation, impact measurement, and related statistical methods, supported by an advanced degree in a STEM field, economics, business informatics, or similar - Deep hands-on analytics coding skills, ideally in both Python and R, with the ability to guide others on methodological and technical quality - Excellent advisory and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders credibly, constructively challenge assumptions, and turn analysis into decisions - Strong business acumen and the ability to focus teams on the work that creates the highest return on investment - A pragmatic consulting mindset paired with strong delivery focus and sound judgment - Fluency in English; German advantageous At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future! #ChallengersWanted Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-SJ1

At ADAO (AI, Data and Agentic Enablement Office), we bring people together to unlock the future of Sunrise through data, analytics, AI, and agentic technologies. We think big, move with purpose, and turn ideas into real impact for our customers and teams. ADAO is where innovation meets trust: we build strong data foundations, scale safe and reliable AI capabilities, and empower business units through a hub‑and‑spoke operating model to deliver meaningful results across the company. Within this model, you will work as part of the Agentic Enablement and Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design team, where the central hub provides standards, platforms, architecture, and best practices, while cross‑functional, outcome‑driven Pods are embedded in and led by the business. You will act as an engineering expert, partnering closely with the business to deliver on their priorities and outcomes. In this role you will enable Sunrise to design, deploy and continuously improve production‑grade agentic and conversational AI solutions across customer and employee workflows. You will provide shared frameworks, standards and quality gates to ensure AI behaviour is predictable, grounded in governed enterprise knowledge and data, safe, multilingual and operationally ready. You will partner with ADAO Domain Pods and engineering teams to accelerate delivery through reusable prompt/agent patterns, evaluation harnesses and disciplined release management. descriptions.it: Bei Sunrise denken wir grösser, gehen weiter und schaffen Neues. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur: gemeinsam Grosses schaffen. Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte. Unsere Front-Line-Heroes sind das Aushängeschild von Sunrise. Sie punkten mit massgeschneiderten Lösungen und Top-Service - so wird aus jedem Kundenkontakt eine langfristige Connection. DEINE CHALLENGE: - Du bist das Gesicht von Sunrise und begeisterst unsere Kundschaft mit deiner positiven Ausstrahlung, deiner zielgerichteten Beratung und dem Verkauf unserer vielfältigen Sunrise Produkte. - Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und sorgst für eine erstklassige Atmosphäre im Shop. - Du unterstützt Kundinnen und Kunden bei Reparatur- und Serviceanliegen und agierst dabei professionell und lösungsorientiert. - Du behältst den Überblick über Lager und Inventur und erledigst administrative • Aufgaben effizient. - Du lebst und repräsentierst die Sunrise Werte – Innovation, Kundennähe und Top-Service. DEINE SKILLS: - Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Detailhandel, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in der Telekommunikations- oder Multimediabranche – oder du bist ein/e motivierte/r Quereinsteiger/-in mit Verkaufsflair. - Du sprudelst vor Begeisterung für Technologie, Telekommunikation und digitale Trends. - Deine Leidenschaft für den Verkauf ist spürbar und dein professionelles Auftreten machen dich zu einem echten Sales-Profi. - Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und die Fähigkeit, ihre Bedürfnisse schnell zu erkennen. - Dank deiner Geduld und deinem technischen Verständnis wirst du ein/e Alltagsheld/-in für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden. - Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus. - Du bringst eine grosse Portion Flexibilität, Zuverlässigkeit und Offenheit für eine schnelllebige Branche mit. Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses. Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert. Bist du bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann werde Teil des Teams und gestalte aktiv unsere Zukunft! #ChallengersWanted Hinweis für Agenturen: Bewerbungsunterlagen, die von Vermittlungsagenturen oder ähnlichen Stellen eingesandt oder hochgeladen werden, sind nicht erwünscht und werden daher nicht berücksichtigt und gelöscht. #LI-TW1

descriptions.it: At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story. Join Our Team as a Customer Experience Manager! Are you passionate about enhancing customer satisfaction and driving excellence? In this pivotal role, you will elevate our customer experience by mapping the end-to-end journey, redesigning and implementing innovative processes, ensuring operational readiness, and spreading the customer’s voice within our organization. Apply now and be part of our Customer Journey Excellence team, as part of Flanker Brands organization! YOUR CHALLENGE: - Define • Requirements: Utilize Agile or Waterfall methodologies to map user journeys, identify journey gaps, define project requirements, and lead operational readiness. Translate complex information into clear, written requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences - Documentation and Analysis: Review, analyze, and create detailed documentation for business rules and work instructions for our agents. Collaborate with key stakeholders to refine agent training and customer’s communication. Create business cases and deep data analysis to identify customer’s needs and measure the post go live effect of our activities - Customer Service SPOC: Serve as the primary contact for Customer Service topics, offering guidance on requirement coverage, processes, and customer experience impacts. Facilitate, negotiate, and mediate between technical and business teams to ensure decisions, enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency - Customer Advocacy: Represent the customer's voice within Flanker Brands to continuously improve customer satisfaction - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with core team members, including Product Managers, Business PMs, IT PMs, trainers, developers, and testers - Go live Support: Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and business validations to ensure solutions meet business needs and customer expectations YOUR SKILLS: - At least 3 years of experience in Business Analysis or Process/Project Management, preferably within telecommunications - Experience working with Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies - Strong focus on customer experience and process improvement with a digital-first mindset - Analytical thinker with a proactive, solution-oriented approach and the ability to adapt to changing business needs - Ability to manage shifting priorities and adapt to evolving directions - Excellent communication, storytelling, interpersonal, teamwork, and organizational skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences effectively At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future! #ChallengersWanted Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-ST1

descriptions.it: A Sunrise, pensiamo più grande, andare oltre e creare nuove cose. Per noi, la cultura del lavoro significa: creare grandi cose insieme. Qui il rispetto e le idee fresche incontrano il lavoro di squadra reale – ogni voce conta, ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a osare cose nuove e a crescere costantemente. Ti sembra? Allora diventa parte della nostra storia di successo. • Cerchiamo una personalità dedicata come Social Media & Community Manager per rafforzare il nostro team Flanker Brands. In questo ruolo, sei responsabile dell'interazione quotidiana con i nostri clienti tramite i marchi yallo, Lebara e CHmobile. Come voce digitale dei nostri marchi, siete in contatto diretto con le nostre comunità sui canali dei social media e su piattaforme di rating come Trustpilot e Google Recensioni. Assicurarsi che ogni interazione rifletta i nostri valori del marchio e contribuisca attivamente alla costruzione di fiducia, fedeltà dei clienti e un'esperienza positiva del cliente. Il vostro lavoro ha un impatto diretto su come i nostri marchi sono percepiti e sperimentati dai clienti. Inoltre, supporta la gestione operativa dei nostri canali di social media coordinando la pianificazione dei contenuti e la pubblicazione in stretta collaborazione con il team. Assicurarsi che il contenuto viene giocato in tempo e costantemente in tutti i canali. descriptions.en: At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new things. For us, working culture means: creating great things together. Here respect and fresh ideas meet real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion drives us to dare new things and to constantly grow. Sounds like you? Then become part of our success story. We are looking for a dedicated personality as Social Media & Community Manager to strengthen our Flanker Brands team. In this role, you are responsible for the daily interaction with our customers via the yallo, Lebara and CHmobile brands. As the digital voice of our brands, you are in direct contact with our communities on social media channels as well as on rating platforms such as Trustpilot and Google Reviews. You ensure that every interaction reflects our brand values and actively contributes to building trust, customer loyalty and a positive customer experience. Your work has a direct impact on how our brands are perceived and experienced by customers. In addition, you support the operational management of our social media channels by coordinating content planning and publishing in close cooperation with the team. You ensure that content is played on time and consistently across all channels. DEINE CHALLENGE: - Support and answering of all community interactions across different channels (Instagram, TikTok, Trustpilot, App Store Reviews, Google Reviews) in a timely and brand-appropriate manner - Appearance as a digital voice of our brands and adaptation of tonality to the respective target groups of yallo, Lebara and CHmobile - Proactive interaction with users (comments, discussions, trends) to strengthen community engagement and brand loyalty - Monitoring and management of critical feedback as well as coordination of escalations with customer care and internal stakeholders - Ensuring a consistent response quality, tonality and brand message across all platforms and touchpoints - Identification of recurring topics and customer feedback as well as derivation of concrete recommendations for action for marketing, product and CX teams - Monitoring, analysis and reporting of relevant community indicators (response times, sentiment, evaluations) as well as derivation of optimization measures - Operational support of social media channels including content planning, publishing and cross-channel coordination DEINE SKILLS: - Completed study At Sunrise, you work in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. descriptions.fr: À Sunrise, nous pensons plus grand, allons plus loin et créons de nouvelles choses. Pour nous, la culture de travail signifie : créer de grandes choses ensemble. Ici le respect et les idées nouvelles rencontrent un véritable travail d'équipe – chaque voix compte, chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à oser de nouvelles choses et à grandir constamment. Vous ressemblez ? Puis faites partie de notre histoire de réussite. Nous recherchons une personnalité dédiée en tant que Social Media & Community Manager pour renforcer notre équipe Flanker Brands. Dans ce rôle, vous êtes responsable de l'interaction quotidienne avec nos clients via les marques yallo, Lebara et CHmobile. En tant que voix numérique de nos marques, vous êtes en contact direct avec nos communautés sur les réseaux sociaux ainsi que sur les plateformes de notation telles que Trustpilot et Google Reviews. Vous veillez à ce que chaque interaction reflète les valeurs de notre marque et contribue activement à renforcer la confiance, la fidélité des clients et une expérience client positive. Votre travail a un impact direct sur la perception et l'expérience de nos marques par les clients. En outre, vous soutenez la gestion opérationnelle de nos canaux de médias sociaux en coordonnant la planification du contenu et la publication en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe. Vous veillez à ce que le contenu soit lu à temps et de manière cohérente sur toutes les chaînes. DEINE CHALLENGE: - Support et réponse de toutes les interactions communautaires entre différents canaux (Instagram, TikTok, Trustpilot, App Store Reviews, Google Reviews) en temps opportun et de manière appropriée - Apparence en tant que voix numérique de nos marques et adaptation de la tonalité aux groupes cibles respectifs de yallo, Lebara et CHmobile - Interaction proactive avec les utilisateurs (commentaires, discussions, tendances) pour renforcer l'engagement communautaire et la fidélité de la marque - Suivi et gestion des réactions critiques ainsi que coordination des escalades avec les clients et les intervenants internes - Assurer une qualité de réponse cohérente, tonalité et message de marque sur toutes les plateformes et tous les points de contact - Identification des sujets récurrents et des réactions des clients ainsi que l'élaboration de recommandations concrètes pour les équipes marketing, produit et CX - Suivi, analyse et rapport des indicateurs communautaires pertinents (temps de réponse, sentiment, évaluations) ainsi que l'élaboration de mesures d'optimisation - Soutien opérationnel des canaux de médias sociaux, y compris la planification du contenu, l'édition et la coordination intersectorielle DEINE SKILLS: - Étude terminée À Sunrise, vous travaillez dans un environnement dynamique et multinational La diversité n'est pas seulement un programme pour nous, mais une partie de notre ADN. Parce que nous célébrons nos différences, nous accomplissons de grandes choses ensemble. descriptions.it: A Sunrise, pensiamo più grande, andare oltre e creare nuove cose. Per noi, lavorare la cultura significa creare grandi cose insieme. Qui il rispetto e le idee fresche incontrano il lavoro di squadra reale – ogni voce conta, ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a osare cose nuove e a crescere costantemente. Ti sembra? Allora diventa parte della nostra storia di successo. I nostri eroi di prima linea sono l'ammiraglia di Sunrise. Punteggi con soluzioni personalizzate e servizio superiore - così ogni contatto cliente diventa una connessione a lungo termine. Siamo alla ricerca di veri sfidanti – e trovare il negozio giusto per voi! Vuoi fare parte del nostro team, ma non sei sicuro di quale posizione sia meglio per te? Nessun problema. Dopo aver ricevuto la vostra richiesta, controlliamo i vostri documenti e li confrontiamo con i posti vacanti nei nostri negozi nella regione di Zurigo. È così che funziona: 1. Applicare: Invia il tuo dossier completo direttamente online. Assicuratevi di includere tutti i documenti rilevanti come i certificati di lavoro e i diplomi. Inoltre, rispondi ad alcune domande sulla tua disponibilità – in modo da poterti assegnare in modo ottimale ad un negozio adatto. 2. Esame: Controlliamo la vostra esperienza e desideri e li confrontiamo con i posti vacanti attuali nei nostri negozi. Entro una settimana, di solito riceverete il feedback iniziale da noi. 3. Invitation: Se il tuo profilo ci si adatta, ti invitiamo a una conversazione virtuale con uno dei nostri Store Manager. Cogliete questa opportunità per convincervi – preparatevi a coinvolgere il mondo dei prodotti di Sunrise e i nostri valori aziendali. La tua sfida: • Sei il volto di Sunrise e ispira i nostri clienti con il tuo carisma positivo, il tuo consiglio mirato e la vendita dei nostri diversi prodotti Sunrise. • Costruire relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine e fornire un'atmosfera di prima classe nel negozio. • Supporti i clienti con problemi di riparazione e servizio e agisci professionalmente e orientata alla soluzione. • Tenere traccia delle scorte e dell'inventario ed eseguire in modo efficiente i compiti amministrativi. • Vivi e rappresenti i valori Sunrise – innovazione, prossimità del cliente e servizio eccellente. I tuoi omicidi: • Hai completato un apprendistato nel commercio al dettaglio, idealmente con esperienza nell'industria delle telecomunicazioni o multimediale – o sei un concorrente laterale motivato con un tocco di vendita. • Voi siete appassionati di tecnologia, telecomunicazioni e tendenze digitali. • La tua passione per le vendite è evidente e il tuo aspetto professionale ti rende un vero professionista delle vendite. • Ti piace trattare con le persone e la capacità di riconoscere rapidamente le loro esigenze. • Grazie alla vostra pazienza e comprensione tecnica, diventerete un eroe di tutti i giorni per i nostri clienti. • Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco, ogni altra lingua è un plus. • Portate molta flessibilità, affidabilità e apertura a un settore in rapida evoluzione. A Sunrise, si lavora in un ambiente dinamico e multinazionale dove ogni voce viene ascoltata, le prospettive sono condivise e i valori sono vissuti. La diversità non è solo un programma per noi, ma parte del nostro DNA. Perché celebriamo le nostre differenze, otteniamo grandi cose insieme. Sunrise è un partner di Advance Gender Equality in Business, l'etichetta LGBTI svizzera e certificata con Fair-ON-Pay Advanced per un lavoro di pari valore per tutti. Sei pronto per la sfida? Allora diventa parte del team e forma attivamente il nostro futuro! #ChallengersWanted nota per le agenzie: I documenti di domanda presentati o caricati da agenzie di collocamento o enti simili non sono desiderati e quindi non sono considerati e cancellati. #LI-TW1 #

At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you identify and acquire qualified business contacts. With your strong understanding of B2B markets, your data-driven approach, and your excellent communication skills, you unlock new sales potential and actively contribute to the sustainable growth of our company.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Identify and proactively approach potential business customers
- Develop and implement lead generation strategies and prepare qualified contacts
- Schedule appointments and hand them over to the sales team
- Develop tailored solutions based on customer needs
- Build and maintain long-term customer relationships
- Collaborate closely with the marketing team to execute sales campaigns
- Use CRM and analytics tools to optimize and streamline processes

YOUR SKILLS:

- Experience in sales, telemarketing, or B2B lead generation
- Strong communication and negotiation skills
- Proficiency in using CRM systems and digital sales tools
- Independent, structured, and goal-oriented working style
- Analytical thinking and strong problem-solving abilities
- Team-oriented with a high level of assertiveness
- Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

Pianificazione e servizio di guardia in tutti i settori rilevanti di Fieldforce - Assunzione di compiti speciali in collaborazione con il caposquadra, HFCS e management specializzato e realizzazione autonoma di lavori di progetto LE VOSTRE COMPETENZE: - Tirocinio completato come ingegnere elettronico multimediale, tirocinio IT con specializzazione in tecnologia di sistemi o installatore elettrico - Scuola tecnica superiore, TS o formazione specialistica a tempo parziale - Esperienza pratica nell'uso e nella risoluzione di problemi in moderne reti di trasmissione, preferibilmente HFC ed esperienza nell'ingegneria elettrica, elettronica, informatica e ingegneria delle comunicazioni - entusiasmo per tecnologia, comprensione dei processi teorici, disponibilità alla formazione continua, flessibilità, capacità di lavorare in squadra - patente di guida Cat. B, BE - buona conoscenza dell'uso del PC, MS Office 365, Sharepoint, team - la conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese è un vantaggio. In Sunrise lavorerai in un ambiente dinamico e multinazionale in cui ogni voce viene ascoltata, le prospettive vengono condivise e i valori vengono vissuti. Per noi la diversità non è solo un programma, ma parte del nostro DNA. Poiché celebriamo le nostre differenze, realizziamo grandi cose insieme. Sunrise è partner di “Advance Gender Equality in Business”, titolare del label svizzero LGBTI e certificata con “Fair-ON-Pay Advanced” per la parità di retribuzione per un lavoro di uguale valore per tutti. Sei pronto per la sfida? Allora entra a far parte del team e plasma attivamente il nostro futuro! #ChallengersWanted Nota per le agenzie: i documenti di candidatura inviati o caricati da agenzie di collocamento o enti simili non sono desiderati e pertanto non verranno presi in considerazione e verranno eliminati. #LI-SJ1

Then become part of our success story. Fieldforce is responsible for the operation and maintenance of the HFC infrastructure and ensures availability and quality in collaboration with internal and external organizations and partners. B, BE - good PC user knowledge, MS Office 365, Sharepoint, teams - German and good English skills are an advantage. At Sunrise you will work in a dynamic and multinational environment in which every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. For us, diversity is not just a program, but part of our DNA. Because we celebrate our differences, we achieve great things together. descriptions.en: At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. formal certification in BPMN 2.0 (e.g., OCEB) - Experience: 3+ years in process management or business analysis, preferably within a complex technical environment like Telco or IT Services - Ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear, business-focused solutions for non-technical stakeholders - Proven experience navigating multi-dimensional service environments with high-dependency systems, such as Billing, IT, and Retail - Practical knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies with a focus on eliminating process waste and reducing manual overhead - Proficient in using Process Mining or data logs to identify root causes of journey friction and customer pain points - Expert user of process modelling and collaboration tools (e.g., Signavio, Miro, Visio) to design airtight, scalable journey logic At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived.
